tools.name: list_reviews
tools.description: List your recent design reviews pushed from the Design Review browser extension (newest first): website, title, time, comment count and the reviewId to pass to get_review. Use this to pick which review to apply.

tools.name: get_latest_review
tools.description: Get the most recent design review as Markdown feedback (comments, selectors, computed styles, console/network errors, screenshot URLs).

tools.name: get_review
tools.description: Get one design review by id as Markdown feedback. Obtain the id from list_reviews.

tools.name: open_review_link
tools.description: Open a design review from a share link somebody sent you (a /r/<id>?t=… URL) and get its feedback as Markdown. Use this when the user pastes a review link rather than asking for their own reviews — the link carries its own access, so the review does not need to have been pushed from this machine. It

tools.name: get_screenshot
tools.description: View a comment's screenshot inline (clients don't fetch image URLs themselves). Pass the reviewId and the comment id shown next to the screenshot in get_review.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_reviews, get_latest_review, get_review, open_review_link, get_screenshot · Public sink: open_review_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_reviews, get_latest_review, get_review, open_review_link, get_screenshot · Public sink: open_review_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
